title: T-20261002-06 / bus #693 — MAY THAT: installer DA KEYLESS (dinh chinh #695) + ket qua test
body:
WIN bao cao test lai ban moi nhat tren may that (DESKTOP-852P1LT, Windows 11 26200, user khong phai admin).

DINH CHINH bus-686 #695: installer /dl/MeetFlowAI-Setup-latest.exe (md5 a0b7c78f...) KHONG phai client cu con key. WIN da TRICH payload ngay trong chinh installer do (chay /DIR trong workspace, bat MeetFlowAI.Win.dll truoc khi rollback): sha256 5913C6BC7469FDA0314A2F8D318F94960342AAAA2E866754CADF5E1D84A50C9D = dung DLL cua publish MeetFlowAIInstallerBuild-20261002-164453 (ban keyless, cee56ee). Quet SonioxApiKey/OpenRouterApiKey/PortableSecret/IsAutoActivatedMachine/LicenseSecret = 0. => Ban con key la overlay ZIP, KHONG phai installer. Viec publish lai ZIP tu 99da3f2 van can (phien WIN khac da ack bus-686).

KET QUA TREN MAY THAT:
(1) /ai/buy 6/6 trang (mac dinh/vi/en/zh/ja/ko) HTTP 200, href duy nhat .../MeetFlowAI-Setup-latest.exe?v=a0b7c78f...
(2) Tai that 52177349 B, md5 a0b7c78f5963dda7f5e8d5341a0e7de6, sha256 4e832ebff9233b617920a51feb336e88659a39bcd38aa875dacad3643fa095cf, magic MZ + chuoi 'Inno Setup'; HEAD 200 application/octet-stream.
(3) Chay app tu DUNG payload cua installer: --protect-config tao appsettings.dat DPAPI 502 B, xoa plaintext; cua so 'MeetFlowAI 2.0' 900x640, Responding=True, 14 control UIA (Start/Stop live translation, Activate, Generate AI meeting minutes, Save transcript...).
(4) Backend that tu may that: GET /health 200; POST /tmp-key 201 (snx_ 147 ky tu); POST /summary 200 provider=openrouter; POST /chat 200.

CHUA CAI THAT DUOC (khong phai loi goi): installer giai nen du 486 file roi Inno exit 4 'RegCreateKeyEx failed; code 5 Access is denied' — sandbox DSH workspace-write chan ghi registry HKCU (do lai: New-Item HKCU:\Software\__dsh_regtest => denied). Xin nang quyen danger-full-access bi tu choi (no approval channel). Can chay buoc cai that trong phien khong sandbox.

KHUYEN NGHI: (a) KY AUTHENTICODE installer + app (hien tat ca NotSigned, Smart App Control dang bat — policy {0283ac0f-...}); (b) chay lai 5-7 cua Release Workflow ngoai sandbox; (c) chu du an rotate Soniox + OpenRouter.

Bang chung: docs/evidence/T-20261002-06/README.md (+ public-download.json, uia-controls.txt, backend-probe.txt, install-inno.log, app-window.png); so: T-20261002-06 (owner->win, transcribed tu bus #693 vi TG-VIBECODE la owner->mac nen WIN khong the ack).
